summary: Satya, co-host of Melanin Millennials, publicly details the forced removal from the podcast by Shout Out Network (SON) CEO M.R.A.L. Morgan and founder Effie, revealing that SON acquired the show's trademark without consent and replaced him with new hosts in August 2017. Satya states he was denied his rights as a co-creator despite working on the show since 2015 based on verbal agreements, and declares his intent to reclaim ownership of the content he created.
